_howToEdit: To add a photo, put the image (.webp or .jpg, ideally at least 1200px wide) in public/gallery/ and add an entry to the right section's photos list, e.g. { "file": "oasis-prototype.webp", "alt": "What the photo shows, for screen readers", "caption": "Optional short caption" }. Use "description" for a short line of text under the section heading. Only publish photos everyone in them has agreed to.

photos.alt: The assembled Oasis probe: a red 3D-printed handle with a black threaded sensor head holding several water sensors, next to its white protective cap.
3D-printed Oasis parts on a workbench: two handle prototypes in red and orange, and the sensor-head mount.
Two Oasis circuit boards on a bench, one wired up to sensors and a probe, beside the assembled red probe with its cap fitted.
The Saline Supernova unit: a tall black-framed cabinet with blue acrylic panels showing the team logo, filter cartridges inside and a water container on top.
Inside a Saline Supernova rig: a blue pre-filter housing, a pump and two white filter cartridges connected by tubing on a wooden board, with the control electronics on top.
Close-up of the Saline Supernova control circuit board, with its button panel and small display, mounted on a grey plate.
Top-down CAD drawing of the microfluidic chip design, showing its inlets, channels and chambers.
3D CAD view of the microfluidic chip, with its channels, mixing sections and reservoir inside a clear block.
Three team members at a workbench, one pointing at a row of stepper-motor syringe pumps.
Team members in blue gloves working together on a small part at a bench.
Two team members reviewing hand-drawn design sketches spread out on the floor.
A lab bench set up for a nitrate assay: pipettes, colour reagent bottles, sample tubes and the assay instructions.
Labelled sample tubes for a nitrate standard series, from 1000 down to 50, in a green tube rack.
Two team members in lab coats and gloves working together at a lab bench.
Two team members at a desk with a microscope and glassware, one smiling at the camera while preparing leaf samples.
Close-up of two small tubes of green plant extract on a desk, with a syringe, a vial and glassware behind.
An improvised bench of glassware, a drill, lemon juice, distilled water, a syringe and leaves, with small tubes of green extract.
A clear chip with a spiral channel, a 3D-printed tube holder, funnels and a vial on a lab balance.
A clear plastic tray next to a rack of pipette tips and glass beakers on a lab bench.
